findings.title: Attention-cost law k*=d*ctx/32 with rigidity converse (companions: AttentionDepthRigidity, Bridges/DeepestRungGapConcavity + Packages/net_43)
findings.idea: If every layer is nonexpansive and top-k truncation deviates by a scale-free Zipf tail A*ctx/k, errors add linearly along depth and the least sufficient budget is exactly ceil(A*d*ctx/delta); conversely ANY cost law with context-invariant speedup plus depth-linear leg is forced to the bilinear form, so our 7B knee k*=8@512 sitting far below bilinear prediction means one hypothesis measurably fails.
findings.use: Go/no-go gate for 30-70B pruning. Experiment (torch Runner, layer-streamed from cached HF safetensors so only one 32B layer is resident at a time on 31GB): (a) power-iterate spectral norms along each layer's V/O path to get Lipschitz constants Lambda_i (no top-k sweep needed per DepthRigidity); (b) run full-vs-top-k per layer on Qwen2.5-7B@ctx512 prose/code, record per-layer deviation eps_i; pre-register end-to-end deviation <= sum eps_i. Decision rule: all Lambda_i <= 1+c/d => knee grows ~linearly with depth, bank on eviction for 32B; any fixed-expansive layer => row-pruning dies for that architecture. Also fit sorted-tail exponent alpha per model (net_43's closed form gives width for any tau; concavity means affine extrapolation over-predicts, so use chord bounds) to bound the unmeasured 14B/32B knees BEFORE sweeping.

findings.title: Margin law: argmax survives top-k truncation when rho > 1 - m/(4LB) (with AttentionMarginLaw's two-sided deficit)
findings.idea: A truncated-and-renormalized attention row moves the read-out by at most 2(1-rho)*B where B bounds value norms, and an argmax survives perturbation below half its logit margin m, so prediction is provably preserved once retained mass exceeds 1 - m/(4LB) -- a threshold set by measured logit margins, not by the 0.98 mass bar.
findings.use: The lever to push BELOW k*=8. Runner cell: dual forward passes (full vs top-k attention) on Qwen2.5-7B@ctx512 over prose+code calibration, dump per-position logits; measure margin distribution m and per-layer value-norm bound B; compute certified rho*(m)=1-m/(4LB). Pre-registrable: (P-a) law-1's 0.985 accuracy at k=8 implies m > 1.4*L*B (MarginLaw's falsifiable inequality); (P-b) certified rho* < observed retention at k=8, licensing k in {4,6} runs with provable argmax preservation; (P-c) NET-88-style context explosion appears as margin collapse at ctx={1024,4096}, converting context acceleration into a parameter-free knee predictor. Margin-adaptive k needs no labels online -> ship as llama.cpp eviction policy.

findings.title: Finite-temperature pruning certificate: defect = tau*log(1+sum_dropped exp((x_j-s)/tau))
findings.idea: If every dropped coordinate's score sits below the max of the retained set, log-sum-exp aggregation changes by at most tau*log(|R|+1), with the exact defect decaying exponentially in the pruned margin delta -- a per-position, per-head computable error certificate for softmax attention truncation.
findings.use: Turns the empirical knee into a runtime-adaptive controller. Build: extract true pre-softmax scores in the Runner at ctx512/7B, implement the exact defect formula, validate it upper-bounds observed output drift and PPL-delta at k=8 (calibration plot). Then patch llama.cpp: truncate a head only when its live tail clears the bound. Pre-register: (P-a) certificate holds >=98% of positions at fixed quality; (P-b) adaptive-k beats fixed k*=8 on tokens/sec at equal PPL on the i9-9900K build because low-margin positions shrink k; (P-c) positions admitting k<k* are exactly those with pruned-margin >> tau. Chains with finding 2 (margin channel) into one instrumentation pass.

findings.title: Top-k set stability under uniform score perturbation: 2*eta < Delta certifies identical selection
findings.idea: With a gap Delta between selected and unselected attention scores, any perturbation of all scores bounded by eta < Delta/2 leaves the selected top-k set provably unchanged (subset and superset invariance both proved).
findings.use: First theorem coupling law 1 to law 2. Cell: log top-k score gaps Delta at k={16,16,8} across layers/heads/positions; compute eta_q8 empirically as sup|score(fp16)-score(K8)| from dual fp16/K8 Runner passes. Pre-register: (P-a) K8's quality-freeness shows as >95% cells with 2*eta_q8 < Delta at 7B; (P-b) the residual uncertified cells localize exactly where PPL degrades, and a mixed K8/K16 per-head policy closes that residual gap at half the K16 cost; (P-c) since eta scales ~2^-b, the same measurement predicts how far below 8 bits SELECTED keys can drop -- sizing the next KV-format step after K8/V4.

findings.title: Windowed tropical decoder: exactness condition and matching cost/reliability converse
findings.idea: If a length-b window contains one informative step (transfer diameter <= theta) and the truncated decision wins by 2*theta it equals the full-horizon decision EXACTLY; window failure <= (n+1-b)(1-p)^b and no windowed decoder beats exponent b*log(1/(1-p)), so optimal depth b* ~ log(1/eps)/log(1/(1-p)) -- a formal model of speculative draft depth with domain-parameterized informativeness rate p.
findings.use: Pure-analysis cell on the already-staged NET-91 harness (7B Q4_K_M target; drafts {0.5B-q8, 1.5B-q4}; depths {2,4,8}; prose/code): add per-step margin logging to drafts, define p_hat = fraction of steps whose top-1 margin clears theta. Pre-register P5': accept/exact-match curves follow 1-(n+1-b)(1-p_hat)^b and measured b* tracks the formula per domain (explains P3 crossover and sharpens P4 code>prose via KMerAvoidance distinct-ngram counts); BirthdayBoundHierarchy adds invariant-FLOPs-per-accepted-token across depths as a free no-free-lunch check; RLHFTemperatureLimits bounds best possible acceptance from draft-target logit range. Zero new infrastructure; converts law 4 from grid facts into a two-sided theory.

findings.title: Cauchy-Schwarz mass floor sqrt(k/N_eff) and the mass/accuracy separation (with Logic/AttentionSelectionDilution)
findings.idea: Top-k retained mass <= sqrt(k/N_eff), so retaining fraction rho forces k >= rho^2*N_eff; yet N_eff does not control the knee -- at N_eff=152.11 any 64-key budget keeps <=65% mass while accuracy stays 0.985, proving accuracy robustness is not mass retention; separately no fixed budget retains fixed mass if effective support grows with context.
findings.use: (1) Deployable guardrail: collision mass sum p^2 is one fused extra reduction inside the existing attention reduction -- emit certified lower bound k >= rho^2*N_eff during prefill as the runtime floor telling the 30-70B server when aggressive pruning is impossible. (2) Metric redirect: stop scoring eviction schemes by retained-mass (H2O-style); switch benchmarks to downstream-accuracy-at-budget -- this provably re-orients the program. (3) Free ablations: Dilution proves random-k control captures exactly k/ctx, so selection advantage is computable offline from already-stored attention maps; pre-register that gap-to-random shrinking is the leading indicator of eviction failure at ctx 1024/4096.

findings.title: Order statistics of seed ensembles: median breakdown point vs fragile max (bundle: Tropical/KneeMedian/TropicalRobustness, KneeStaircaseArithmetic, KneeResolutionLimits, ProofSpacePhaseTransition, Physics/LowTailOrderStatistics)
findings.idea: For three seeds the median has breakdown point one (a single corrupted seed cannot move it outside the other two's span) while the all-seeds-safe maximum has breakdown zero; medians sit at exactly (7/8)*d*ctx/32; a knee's robustness radius equals its measurement margin, certifiable context-doublings are antitone in noise, and antitonicity of the quality-vs-k curve guarantees a unique crossing.
findings.use: Protocol upgrade costing near-zero compute, hardening every future law-1/5 record: adopt median-of-seeds as the deployable budget (formalized 8x guaranteed / 9.14x median speedup window at d=4); certify a cell only when knee margin > inter-seed spread, else publish brackets; add monotonicity assertion per layer so the 0.98 crossing is unique (ProofSpacePhaseTransition); check existing multi-seed records for staircase-number AP triples with mean=median (free falsification of KneeStaircaseArithmetic); halve grid steps at future ctx-4096 rungs (resolution doubles per rung); LowTailOrderStatistics sizes how many bits non-selected keys need from the k*-th/(k*+1)-th score-gap distribution.

findings.title: Price of universality: serving m classes costs log2(m) bits total (bundle: UniversalRedundancyConservation/Library/Average, compression_research_a1 + submodular-library record)
findings.idea: One shared decompressor serving m specialized source classes pays at most log2(m) bits TOTAL extra (Shtarkov-sum subadditivity); specializing moves exactly log2#kappa bits from message to decompressor identity; library price is submodular so greedy selection is (1-1/e)-optimal and mixtures add nothing.
findings.use: Direct counter-strategy to law 5's +25-33% mixed-domain key tax. Experiment 'switched-specialized vs universal': at equal RAM compare (a) single mixed-domain key budget {16,20} (NET-90 config) vs (b) per-domain key sets switched by a ~log2(m)-bit domain tag, on pure/mixed streams at ctx512/1024. Pre-register: switching wins once the mixed premium exceeds the log2(m)-equivalent cost, and overhead scales like log2(#domains) not linearly across 2/3/4-domain mixtures. Same machinery greedily selects the resident speculative-draft library from cached {0.5B,1.5B} scored on domain corpora -- mixture-is-free guarantees overlapping drafts carry no penalty.

findings.title: Quantized weight lattices: rounding preserves L-Lipschitz loss up to L*r/2; strong convexity pins minimizers (4-file family with SharpConstant)
findings.idea: Delta-grid rounding of weights preserves any L-Lipschitz loss up to L*(r/2) so no global optimum is lost, strongly convex losses keep lattice minimizers within sqrt(2Lr/mu) of the true one, and the exact worst-case midpoint defect of grid rounding is proved -- the closest thing in the catalog to GGUF quantization theory.
findings.use: Gives law 3 its missing theory AND a planning tool for the big-model push. Cell: in the Runner, perturb dequantized tensors by controlled steps r, fit local Lipschitz constant L of layer-output/perplexity loss per tensor type; pre-register PPL(qW) <= PPL(W)+L*r reproduces the measured fp16->q2_k ladder including why q2_k lands at only +16%, and the strong-convexity leg explains why calibration+scale search finds equivalent minima. Payoff: extrapolate the ladder for 14B/32B checkpoints from 7B-calibrated L values BEFORE spending NVMe-hours quantizing them -- pick the smallest bit-width meeting the quality budget for the single-digit-GRAM target.

findings.title: Kraft converse: entropy coding achieves [H, H+1) bits, nothing lossless beats H (with Probability/SparseEntropyLowerBound)
findings.idea: Any length function with Kraft sum <= 1 is realized by an explicit prefix-free code, so optimal expected description length lies in [H(p), H(p)+1); a k-sparse index mask carries exactly binEntropy(k/N)*N bits, e.g. log2 C(512,16) ~ 118 bits/row instead of raw pointers.
findings.use: New RAM lever beyond K8/V4: the WHICH-keys sidecar of sparse/top-k KV. Cell: instrument the Runner to log per-layer selected-key index sequences at ctx512 for 0.5B/1.5B/7B, estimate empirical entropy H; compare H+1 bits/token against baseline k*log2(ctx) (72 bits at k=8,ctx512). Pre-register: selections skew toward recent/local positions so H << baseline; if confirmed, build a range-coded index stream in the llama.cpp fork and measure tokens/sec overhead (<few %) vs bytes saved per row. SparseEntropyLowerBound supplies the exact mask-coding ceiling so we can prove the sidecar never rivals the KV payload it saves.

findings.title: Per-component approximation errors add exactly: linear composition law (with Applications/AlmostLossless/Blocks union-bound composition)
findings.idea: For n parallel sites each degraded by delta, total induced error is exactly n*delta (linear, not worse), giving a per-site precision requirement Delta*e^{-M}/n; block version composes as 1-(1-eps)^{LT}, setting allowed per-layer eps = 1-(0.98)^{1/(LT)}.
findings.use: Mixed-precision layer assignment -- the principled alternative to uniform K-quants when every GB counts. Cell: build per-layer-quantized GGUF variants of Qwen2.5-7B (llama.cpp quantize tensor-type overrides, one layer at q4/q3 at a time), run perplexity binary per variant to get 28-32 single-layer sensitivities. Pre-register: all-layers-quantized degradation ~= sum of singles within measured curvature; then solve the tiny knapsack 'which layers get q8 vs q4/q2 under a RAM budget' and verify predicted-vs-measured PPL of the optimal mixed build. This is the concrete recipe for squeezing 30B-class weights toward single-digit GB better than any uniform ladder point.

findings.title: Critical geometry under bounded recoding: thresholds shift additively by at most the encoding overhead
findings.idea: Two prefix-free encodings of the same system translating with additive length overhead at most b distort cumulative counts by radial shift <= b (N1(n) <= N2(n+b)), so critical crossing indices move by at most b under recoding -- never multiplicatively.
findings.use: Decisive cheap control on the NET-88 tokenizer tax. Rerun English-vs-German knee curves (cached corpora, existing harness) and test additive-shift vs multiplicative-amplification: predicted knee shift <= b tokens (b = German fine-tokenization overhead ~+4%). Pre-register: if the measured ctx=4096 shift exceeds b, the >=+16-key amplification is a genuine model-side effect (chain to MarginLaw: language shift collapses logit margins) and multilingual serving needs more keys or margin-aware budgets; if it matches b, most of the explosion is a token-counting artifact and the fix is accounting, not capacity. Either outcome resolves an open interpretation of law 5 for the price of one sweep.

topic_notes:
DEDUP + RANK LOGIC: eight territories returned ~90 findings; heavy overlap collapsed them to 12 entries. The Probability/Logic/Bridges attention files were reported by 2-3 miners each (AttentionCostLaw x2 @10, TruncationOutput x2 @9, Concentration x2, KneeMedianLaw x2, SelectionDilution x2, CompressionDelta/a2 x2, UniversalRedundancy family x5 across Cryptography/Applications/Logic/NumberTheory/Packages) -- I merged companions into single entries and folded secondary results (Maslov softmax-to-max certificate, net_43 concavity/tail ceilings, KMerAvoidance, BirthdayBoundHierarchy, RLHFTemperatureLimits) into the uses of their parent experiments. All 37 load-bearing paths verified on disk: 111-696 lines with genuine theorem density, no stubs among the picks.

META-SURPRISE (biggest structural fact): large parts of this catalog are FORMALIZATIONS OF OUR OWN PROGRAM -- Probability/Attention{CostLaw,Concentration,TruncationOutput,MarginLaw,DepthRigidity}, Logic/Knee{Fluctuation,Drift,Median,Quota,ResolutionLimits}, Logic/AttentionSelection*, Geometry/KneeScalingRays, NumberTheory/KneeStaircaseArithmetic, Tropical/KneeMedian/LabNotesNET48 reference NET-36..48 numbers verbatim (N_eff=152.11, k*=d*ctx/32, ray slopes 1/8 and 7/64). These are the highest-value finds because they convert validated laws into certified bounds, uniqueness results (one constant fits), and pre-registered falsification tests -- KneeScalingRays alone hands us three checkable inequalities for the planned ctx=4096 cell (median-ray prediction 7/64*4096=448, low tail permitted to break scaling).

LAW-EXTENSION FLAGS (request 3): LAW 1 (knee) now has a three-legged certification stack ready to test: Cauchy-Schwarz budget k>=rho^2*N_eff (Concentration/Dilution), margin threshold rho>1-m/(4LB) with two-sided deficit (TruncationOutput/MarginLaw), and concave selection-gap geometry with closed-form power-tail ceilings (DeepestRungGapConcavity/net_43); DepthRigidity adds a purely spectral feasibility pre-check for 30-70B. LAW 2 (KV cliff) is the LEAST extended: three partial candidates -- NeuralCodeRateCeiling (GV/sphere-packing sandwich could derive the ~8-bit death threshold from capacity vs required key population), Bridges/SourceCoding + TropicalRateDistortionExact (H_infinity/max-leakage worst-case lens plausibly explains WHY keys die and values survive -- measurable as H_inf(key) > H_inf(value)), RotatedLaplacianQuantization (exact-or-catastrophic dichotomy predicting a forbidden band of intermediate key damage -> quarantine detector); nearest complete result is only the symmetric Frobenius KV bound (TransformerApproximation). Nothing derives asymmetric K/V precision from first principles -- open theory slot we could fill ourselves. LAW 3 gets QuantizedWeightLattices + QuantizedBarrier (L2 grid-error floor computable offline from cached weights) + FisherCramerRao (is K8 AT the Cramer-Rao floor => optimal, or above => smarter decoder headroom?). LAW 4 gets its first formal theory via the windowed-decoder exactness/converse pair. LAW 5 splits into four measurable mechanisms: log2(m) universality price, fiber conditional entropy (FiberEntropyFrontier), KL chain-rule parse divergence (UniversalRedundancyCapacityParse), and mixture-induced power laws (ProofRegimeMixturePowerLaw discriminates regime-heterogeneity vs new cross-domain attention structure for NET-89/90).

COMPUTE-SAVING NEGATIVE RESULTS (skip these arms): derandomization theorems (rng_no_rate_advantage in Applications/AlmostLossless/RandomCoding; PrivateAverageDistortion convexity converse) prove randomized/stochastic eviction cannot beat deterministic at equal failure rate -- do not run that A/B except as a one-cell confirmation; the mass/accuracy separation theorem says retained-mass metrics are provably the wrong objective; AlmostLossless/Optimal's epsilon-quantile knee predictor will fail by construction (mass knee >=146 vs accuracy knee 64 at N_eff=152.11) -- run only if we want a confirming falsification of the mass channel; SearchCostSeparation licenses skipping the 0.5B draft entirely on high-concentration domains where ngram tables suffice.

BARREN AREAS (consensus): Speculative/ territory proper (sci-fi: RudyRucker, SciFi, Consciousness), mainstream crypto (BB84/FHE/LWE/ZK/Shamir), Wigner semicircle / Ising / percolation / PlanckFoam physics, Berggren triples / Chebotarev geodesics / Langlands / moonshine number theory, proof-system information theory (correct math, wrong object), immune-system calculators, auto-generated ML stubs (LLMSingleMatMul, BackpropCotangent=True, InformationGeometry_Theorems empty, TropicalentropyDefs broken placeholder in TWO directories pointing at ../../Shared/TropicalEntropy/Defs.lean). SYSTEMATIC GAPS relevant to us: NO Johnson-Lindenstrauss/sketching/streaming-sublinear algorithms anywhere; NO online-algorithms/caching theory (no paging, LRU competitive analysis, ski-rental -- the tropical amortization thread is the only substitute); no matrix/low-rank approximation theory beyond CombSchmidtRank's periodicity remark; no memory-bandwidth, cache-blocking, or CPU-execution theory (TropicalPerronFrobenius max-plus bottleneck analysis and PerformanceEnvelope affine bands are the only usable frames); no RoPE/positional theory; no speculative-acceptance theory before the DecodingTradeoff file. Bottom line: the catalog pays off exactly where it PRICES COMPRESSION AND SELECTION ERRORS -- enough verified material for roughly six concrete experiment cells against our five laws, dominated by the knee-certification cluster.
